name: Sys2Rust System, Shell & PE Workstation
description: 48-tool pure-Rust & Win32/ETW Windows process, hardware/firmware, shell/registry, and PE32/PE32+/.NET inspection suite with dual Win32/Iced GUIs, CLI, Merkle custody reports, and policy-gated MCP server.
majorCapabilities: 13 process, thread, handle (with named-pipe deadlock guard), heap, GDI, hang, and passive ETW monitors (zero DLL injection)
10 hardware, service, driver, device, Task Scheduler XML, WMI, pure-Rust SMBIOS/ACPI firmware, battery, codec, and timezone tools
19 shell, startup, uninstall, MSI/Appx, shell extension, file association, COM, desktop icon layout, tray notify ROT13, and read-only privacy audit tools
6 pure-Rust PE32/PE32+ & ECMA-335 .NET tools (exports, resources, ICO reassembly, .NET resources, executable info, GAC)
Native Win32 (WinSafe) & Iced 0.14 dual GUIs, 7-format guap-export + SHA-256/512 Merkle custody, and policy-gated MCP stdio server

tools.summary: Inspect smart battery capacities, wear level, voltage, and charge rate via IOCTL_BATTERY
Inspect installed MFT, Drivers32, and SYSTEM.INI audio/video codecs
Inspect PnP devices, status, problem codes, hardware IDs, and drivers
Inspect loaded kernel-mode device drivers and base addresses
Inspect and decode SMBIOS and ACPI firmware tables with checksum validation
Inspect Windows services, status, startup type, binary path, and account
Resolve Windows Known Folders (FOLDERID_*) and CSIDL paths
Inspect Windows Scheduled Tasks via TaskScheduler COM and Task XML parser
Inspect Windows time zones, REG_TZI_FORMAT biases, and DST rules
Execute WQL queries against WMI namespaces with SAFEARRAY & DMTF handling
Inspect ECMA-335 .NET assembly metadata and ManifestResource streams
Inspect named, ordinal-only, and forwarded DLL exports in pure Rust
Enumerate .NET Global Assembly Cache (GAC) assemblies and versions
Inspect and reassemble RT_GROUP_ICON / RT_GROUP_CURSOR payloads
Inspect PE32/PE32+ headers, version strings, Authenticode signature presence, and compiler hints
Inspect embedded .rsrc Win32 resources with MIME detection and SHA-256
Aggregate per-file I/O activity via passive ETW Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-File
Capture passive debug/module events without DLL injection
Inspect loaded DLL modules across processes with version metadata
Inspect process PEB RTL_USER_PROCESS_PARAMETERS current directory and environment variables
Monitor process start/stop and image loads via passive ETW Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Process
Inspect per-process GDI and USER object handle counters
Inspect open kernel handles per process with synchronous pipe deadlock guard
Diagnose hung windows using Wait Chain Traversal (WCT) and StackWalk64
Inspect process heap blocks and ASCII/hex previews via ToolHelp + ReadProcessMemory
Enumerate running Windows processes, command lines, memory counters, CPU time, and integrity levels
Inspect virtual address space regions via VirtualQueryEx and GetMappedFileNameW
Inspect open file handles across processes with FILE_TYPE_PIPE timeout guard
Inspect running Windows threads, start addresses, priorities, states, and wait reasons
Inspect AppCompatFlags\Layers compatibility shims per executable
Inspect UWP/MSIX Appx packages via WinRT PackageManager & AppxManifest.xml
Inspect registered COM/OLE DLLs and missing orphan registrations
Inspect desktop SysListView32 icon coordinates via VirtualAllocEx+ReadProcessMemory & icon profile INI
Inspect User and System environment variables with expanded values
Inspect per-extension ShellEx handlers such as Thumbnail and Preview providers
Inspect registered file extensions, ProgIDs, MIME types, icons, and open commands
Compact installed software uninstaller inventory
Inspect static Explorer context menu verbs under HKCR
Inspect Explorer 'New' submenu ShellNew templates
Inspect MSI products via MsiEnumProductsExW / MsiGetProductInfoExW
Inspect Shell MuiCache entries enriched with executable VS_VERSION_INFO metadata
Inspect applications registered in the Explorer 'Open With' dialog
Read-only audit of RunMRU, TypedPaths, WordWheelQuery, Recent, and Temp artifacts
Inspect registered Explorer Shell Extensions and Approved/Blocked status
Inspect Run keys, StartupApproved binary states, and Startup folders
Inspect TrayNotify ROT13 IconStreams/PastIconsStream and Win11 NotifyIconSettings
Inspect installed programs across HKLM/WOW6432Node/HKCU Uninstall keys
Inspect custom Windows URI/URL protocol handlers
Enable or disable an installed multimedia codec
